description: Defines a class for checking reception windows and collecting related statistics in a radio communication context, including methods for updating and retrieving statistics, and handling symbol timing.

classes.name: ru_emulator_rx_kpis
classes.description: Helper structure with aggregated reception window statistics.

classes.name: ru_emulator_rx_window_checker
classes.description: Class that checks if a symbol is within the reception window and stores statistics.

methods.name: get_statistics
methods.description: Returns the collected reception window statistics.

methods.name: increment_on_time_counter
methods.description: Increments the counter for on-time messages.

methods.name: increment_early_counter
methods.description: Increments the counter for early messages.

methods.name: increment_late_counter
methods.description: Increments the counter for late messages.

methods.name: nof_on_time_messages
methods.description: Returns the number of on-time messages.

methods.name: nof_early_messages
methods.description: Returns the number of early messages.

methods.name: nof_late_messages
methods.description: Returns the number of late messages.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Handles a new symbol event, checking if it is within the reception window.

methods.name: update_rx_window_statistics
methods.description: Updates reception window statistics based on received symbol.
